comparison.report:
TachUI Performance Comparison Report
==================================================

Benchmark Results (lower is better, except ops/sec):

Benchmark | TachUI   | React    | SolidJS 
----------|----------|----------|---------
Create 1K rows (ms) | 24.6     | 45.2     | 22.1    
Replace all (ms) | 33.1     | 47.8     | 24.8    
Partial update (ms) | 33.8     | 23.1     | 8.9     
Select row (ms) | 35.4     | 4.2      | 1.8     
Swap rows (ms) | 26.0     | 8.7      | 3.2     
Remove rows (ms) | 26.7     | 19.3     | 7.1     
Clear rows (ms) | 6.7      | 12.1     | 4.2     
Memory usage (MB) | 2.7      | 8.5      | 4.1     
Bundle size (KB) | 15.8     | 42.2     | 8.9     

Performance Analysis:

vs SolidJS (closest architecture):
  Create performance: 11.3% slower
  Update performance: 279.8% slower
  Memory usage: 34.3% lower

vs React (most popular):
  Create performance: 45.6% faster
  Update performance: 46.3% slower
  Memory usage: 68.3% lower

Overall Performance Ranking:
  🥇 1. SolidJS: 18.6ms avg
  🥈 2. TachUI: 30.5ms avg
  🥉 3. React: 38.7ms avg

TachUI Strengths:

  ✅ Lightweight bundle size
  ✅ Efficient memory usage
  ✅ Fast component creation
